item.title: 2025 WinterFest Columbus Musician Application is NOW OPEN!
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

The musician application for WinterFest Columbus is NOW OPEN!

WinterFest Columbus, presented by Columbus Recreation and Parks Department, is an annual celebration of the winter season in Columbus. This free event features seasonal craft beer and cocktails, live music, some of Columbus' best food trucks, and lots of outdoor winter fun!

The festival will occur on Saturday, December 6, 2025, in downtown Columbus, Ohio. WinterFest Columbus is actively seeking established bands and DJs. Priority is placed on dynamic live performances and musical excellence. Strong marketing materials are required. We encourage you to provide links to videos showcasing your group in a live performance setting, along with recent music samples.

The application and additional information can be found by clicking the button below. All musicians wishing to participate must first complete this application. Submitting an application does not guarantee acceptance. First consideration will be given to applications received by Monday, October 6, 2025. 

Application & Information

item.title: 2025 CBUS Soul® Fest Musician Application is Now Open
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

The application to perform at the 2025 CBUS Soul® Fest is now open!

Celebrate Columbus’ vibrant Black culture during CBUS Soul® Fest! Presented by Columbus Recreation and Parks, CBUS Soul® Fest features live music, great food and lots of soul!

The festival will occur August 15 and 16, 2025, in downtown Columbus, Ohio. We seek established artists and DJs performing music with roots in soul, funk, gospel, R&B and hip-hop/rap.

Additional information and the application can be found by clicking the button below. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, priority will be given to applications submitted by April 7, 2025.

Musician Information

Be sure to follow CBUS Soul® Fest on Facebook and Instagram to stay updated on the hottest event in Columbus!

item.title: 2025 Jazz & Rib Fest Artist Application is Now Open!
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

The application to perform at the 2025 Jazz & Rib Fest is now open!

Jazz & Rib Fest, presented by Columbus Recreation and Parks, will occur July 18, 19 and 20, 2025, in downtown Columbus, Ohio. This FREE festival draws over 200,000 attendees and offers multiple stages with continuous live music. We seek established artists performing music with roots in jazz. Priority is placed on dynamic live performances and musical excellence.

Additional information and the application can be found by clicking the button below. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, priority will be given to applications submitted by Jan. 31, 2025.

Please note, that you are receiving this message because you applied to perform at Jazz & Rib Fest in the past. You may unsubscribe from this list at any time.

Artist Application
